B in sub-rule (2), in clause (ii), for sub-clause (b), the following shall be substituted for 
testing and analysis of Ayurveda, Siddha & Unani drugs namely:- 
“(i) Expert in Ayurveda or Siddha or Unani medicine who possess a degree qualification recognized 
under Schedule II of Indian Medicine Central Council Act, 1970; 
(ii) Chemist, who shall possess at least Bachelor Degree in Science or Pharmacy (Ayurveda) awarded 
by a recognized University ; and 
(iii) Botanist (Pharmacologist), who shall possess at least Bachelor Degree in Science (M edical or 
Pharmacy) or Pharmacy (Ayurveda) awarded by a recognized University.”
